answer: Use proofreading tenure with publisher assignment chain as the proof: books proofed for one publisher across many years. One fake is cheap, but 328 aliases need 328 independent assignment chains, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The vertex check runs in the open: 328 fakes pay the full price 328 times, one honest agent pays once, and the shale trail in the ledger makes the lotus cost visible to everyone.
